speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I am Dr. Agent. Since you are a newborn, I will need to gather specific details from your parents about your recent health and conduct a thorough physical exam. To begin, please tell me if you have noticed any fever, poor feeding, lethargy, or unusual crying patterns in the last 24 hours?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for providing that background; the lack of prenatal care and immunizations is significant. Now, during the physical exam, do you notice any jaundice, respiratory distress, or signs of sepsis like temperature instability or poor tone?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The combination of a continuous heart murmur (likely a patent ductus arteriosus), bluish non-blanching macules (petechiae/purpura), cataracts, and sensorineural hearing loss in a newborn without immunizations is the classic presentation of the "3 Cs" of Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

REQUEST IMAGES: Fetal_Heart_Ultrasound, Fundoscopy_Photos.
